projectDescription: An open-source, plugin-first AI agent harness where every component—model adapters, tool registries, session logs, and the agent loop—is a swappable Cordis plugin.
keyFeatures: Everything is a plugin — model adapters, tool registries, session logs, sandbox, and the agent loop are all swappable Cordis plugins
Plugin system powered by Cordis with dependency injection, typed events, and reversible effect-based registrations
Profiles and bundles — composable layered configuration stacks for different deployment shapes (web, headless, custom)
Web UI for interactive agent sessions with full tool approval flow
Headless CLI mode for one-shot programmatic agent runs
Python SDK for driving the harness as a subprocess via JSON-RPC
Agent Client Protocol (ACP) for automation clients over JSON-RPC stdio
Capability seams — swappable filesystem, shell, sandbox, subagent, and LLM provider backends
Event-sourced append-only session log as the single source of truth for model history
Code Mode — model can call registered tools programmatically via a generated TypeScript SDK
publicApiSurface: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web — start the Web UI
dsh --profile headless "task" — run a one-shot headless agent
dsh plugin --profile <name> <pnpm args> — manage profile plugins
ctx.llm.registerAdapter([provider], adapter) — register an LLM adapter
ctx.agents — live agent registry with factory and event dispatch
ctx.shell / ctx.subprocess / ctx.fs / ctx.sandbox — capability seam service keys
agent.followup() / agent.steer() / agent.inject() — drive an agent programmatically
ctx.on('tools/pre-execute' | 'tools/execute' | 'tools/post-execute', handler) — tool pipeline interception events
ctx.on('agent/pre-step' | 'agent/request' | 'agent/turn-stopping', handler) — agent loop interception events
ctx.on('session/event', handler) — subscribe to the durable session event stream
DeepSeekHarness Python class — high-level Python SDK for running agent tasks
cordis.patch.yml / --patch overlay — layer-based runtime configuration patching
export const inject = [...]; export function apply(ctx) — Cordis plugin shape
